criteria.row: 该期待什么 / row 1 (5 名·可执行单口径·本单这份账)
criteria.verdict_rule: ROW_LABELED_BY_WINDOW iff the value under the 全窗 header and the same book's full-window cell differ by >= tol_pp_per_year; SAME_WINDOW if they do not. IDENTITY_FAILED refuses every printed row when the cell that supplies the full window no longer reproduces the ticket's own published number.
criteria.segment_additivity_rule: the 2020-2023 cell is published only when is.bars + oos.bars == full.bars (|delta| <= 1 bar); otherwise it is withheld and the page prints a dash -- an unsegmented cell is not a zero
criteria.frozen: thresholds written before the first run; --check refuses a face whose criteria moved

printed_under_full_header.source: the ticket's own backtest, as the page prints it today

segments.rule: the 2020-2023 cell is published only when is.bars + oos.bars == full.bars (|delta| <= 1 bar); otherwise it is withheld and the page prints a dash -- an unsegmented cell is not a zero

verdict.why: the value under the 全窗 header is the 2.83-year window; the same book over the full window reads 7.63%, i.e. +4.93 pp/yr and the header is not what the cell holds
